bullets.text: iCloud Search Feature Launched - iOS 26.4 enhances iCloud.com with a new search feature for files and photos.
Siri Mode Coming to Camera - iOS 27 will introduce a new Siri mode for enhanced camera functionality.
MagSafe Now Standard on iPhones - Every new iPhone includes MagSafe, a feature absent in Samsung devices.
John Giannandrea Joins CuspAI - Former Apple AI head to assist UK startup CuspAI with US expansion.
Philips Hue's New Feature - SpatialAware mode enhances smart lighting for a more immersive experience.
New Alarm Feature in iOS 26.4 - iOS 26.4 allows iPhone alarms to sound even when using an Apple Watch.
Apple Reports Record Sales - Despite chip shortages, Apple achieved $111.2 billion in revenue last quarter.
Rivian's Revenue Growth - Rivian's Q1 revenue increased as R2 production ramps up, despite challenges.
Hackers Exploit cPanel Bug - A critical vulnerability in cPanel is being actively exploited by hackers.
OpenAI Enhances ChatGPT Security - New advanced security features launched for ChatGPT accounts, including Yubico partnership.
